source_hypotheses.required: Use actual positive admissible h, fixed negative odd fundamental hstar, coprimality, actual genus character and supplied analytic-rank-zero/one results.
source_hypotheses.constructed: The exact-character subgroup for the actual unaveraged genus point; ranks are inherited hypotheses verified separately for these twists.
source_hypotheses.justification: The accepted genus-character relation supplies the field/character identification; the forward theorem supplies ranks. Neither norm nor positive height is used to manufacture rank one.

constructed_objects.required: Specify the native integral free lattice rather than only a rational eigenspace.
constructed_objects.constructed: For h>1, Gamma_h consists of points P of E(F_h) with tau P=-P exactly, and Lambda_h is Gamma_h modulo its torsion. For h=1, Gamma_1=E(K_1).
constructed_objects.justification: Reindexing the actual unaveraged CM sum gives membership before multiplying by4B or L. The different ring-class lattice is not redefined.

index_domain_coverage.required: Prove the genus rational-subgroup index bound only in the native rank-one setting at known simple zeros.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: The rational h-twist subgroup contains2Lambda_h, so its index is at most two.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Rank one is separately supplied. At nonsimple odd-sign parameters the existing height-zero/torsion branch remains separate and no free-lattice index is assigned to torsion.

transition_maps.required: Identify exact-character points with the twist and use the remaining quadratic involution without changing the integral lattice.
transition_maps.constructed: The standard twist isomorphism identifies Gamma_h with E^(h)(K_h); Q maps under norm to Q+sigma Q in E^(h)(Q).
transition_maps.justification: The complementary hstar-character has rank zero, hence sigma fixes the free class and the norm represents twice that class. This is containment, not integral equality.

limiting_object_identity.required: Keep the same native genus point/lattice and same finite-stage detector when the index bound is consumed.
limiting_object_identity.constructed: The added definition and the later backward reference name the same Gamma_h/Lambda_h and actual genus point; no new limiting object is constructed.
limiting_object_identity.justification: No limit exchange is introduced. Fixed L and changing detector precision remain the existing construction; this norm proof does not establish any ring-class limit statement.

coefficient_conventions.required: Retain unaveraged sums, the standard quadratic twist, the integral norm factor2 and existing detector constants.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: Exact unaveraged P_h membership; norm gives2[Q]; C_det absorbs the same index-at-most-two factor.
coefficient_conventions.justification: Neither class-number averaging nor rational lattice rescaling occurs. No printed constant or coefficient bound changes.

local_conditions.required: Preserve prepared unit classes, split-level CM conditions and the same integral finite-field evaluation.
local_conditions.constructed: The two edits alter only genus-lattice identification and its index justification. Existing local conditions, L and O.7 are retained.
local_conditions.justification: The accepted residual bindings locate the additive integral map and fixed torsion annihilator. The norm calculation does not supply arbitrary local prescriptions.

exceptional_cases.required: Treat h=1 explicitly and keep torsion, nonsimple zeros and ring-class points distinct.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Gamma_1=E(Q(sqrt(hstar))); ordinary conjugation and the same norm prove the bound. No nontrivial tau over K_1 is invented.
exceptional_cases.justification: Torsion is quotiented, not assumed zero. The hstar rank-zero input remains required. Ring-class indices and their separate proofs are unchanged.

downstream_consumption.required: Bind the exact two edits to the native-genus definition and later visibility inequality.
downstream_consumption.justification: The backward reference now identifies the actual earlier norm proof. The existing O.8 valuation/visibility branch uses it with the reviewed mass/index and finite-field inputs; no whole-manuscript approval is asserted.

dependency_impact: Only the native genus lattice definition and its exact index-at-most-two justification are clarified. The separate ring-class lattice, prior rank/CM/local premises, all constants and other combined-batch edits remain outside this contract.
